[SWS_CM_00723] Method to subscribe to a service trigger
⌈
Inside the
specific Trigger class belonging to the specific ServiceProxy class a Subscribe
method shall be provided to start subscription of the corresponding trigger.
ara::core::Result<void> Trigger::Subscribe();
If the Trigger is already subscribed to at the time of the call, and Subscribe() is
invoked, it shall return silently without any action.
⌋
